is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (referred to as 1014F) and L995S (referred to as 1014S) (page 4, Table 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 provides genotype counts (LL, LF, FF) for survivors and dead mosquitoes in both IRS and DL bioassays.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from field sites in Bomi County, Liberia (page 1, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical entomological survey conducted in 2011 (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides specific collection sites in Bomi County, Liberia, with UTM coordinates in Table 1 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a baseline entomological survey conducted in 2011 in Bomi County, Liberia, and does not indicate it is a subset of a larger previously published dataset.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Bomi County, Liberia, in 2011. It combined WHO tube and cone bioassays with molecular analysis of kdr mutations (1014F/S). The study found high resistance to deltamethrin and a high frequency of the 1014F kdr allele, which was significantly associated with survival in IRS bioassays.
